reason: The company has officially disclosed a default in payment of fines and penalties regarding SEBI non-compliance, signaling severe governance and liquidity distress.
why_now: The primary exchange filing regarding the default was released on September 12, 2024.
source_headlines: DPSC Limited: DPSC Limited has informed the Exchange about Delay/default in the payment of fines/penalties/dues etc. to authority regarding Notices for non-compliance with Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations )
